text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This is a report on the refusal to issue a permit by Municipal Licensing and Standards in the matter of an application for a boulevard café permit located at 839 Queen Street West, Niagara Street flankage.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: Approved the proposed boulevard café located at 839 Queen Street West, Niagara Street flankage, with the following conditions: 1. The Licensee shall close and clear the patio of patrons at 11:00 p.m. daily. 2. The Licensee shall not provide or permit any amplified music in outdoor areas of the premises. 3. Windows and doors must remain closed at all times, live or amplified music is played inside the establishment. 4. The Licensee shall ensure that any sound resulting from the operation of the business is not audible beyond a reasonable distance from the lot line of the property on which the premises are located. This clause refers to sound that is generated by any conversation by patrons within the premises, bussing of tables, garbage and bottle disposal.
